settings.text: Only listens while the button is held
You read every word in the app

settings.title: They talk
settings.text: Your child holds the button on Snuggo and says whatever's on their mind: a question, a story idea, how their day went.

settings.title: Snuggo talks back
settings.text: It answers out loud, asks them something back and keeps the story going. No screen involved.

settings.title: You see every word
settings.text: The back-and-forth shows up as a transcript in the free parent app on your phone, in real time.

settings.question: Is it always listening?
settings.answer: No. Snuggo only listens while your child holds its button down. Let go, and the microphone switches off.

settings.question: What gets stored?
settings.answer: Voice clips are turned into text so Snuggo can reply, then deleted. The written transcript goes to your parent app and stays there until you clear it.

settings.question: Who can see the chats?
settings.answer: Only you. Every chat shows up as a live transcript in your parent app, and your child's data is never sold or used for advertising.

settings.question: Does it have a camera?
settings.answer: No. Snuggo has no camera and no screen.

settings.question: Could it say something unsuitable?
settings.answer: It's built for kids, with filters that steer away from grown-up topics, and you can flag any chat for review.

settings.question: Can I set limits?
settings.answer: Yes. Choose topics and a daily time limit in the app. Snuggo stops chatting when time's up.

settings.question: Does it need Wi-Fi?
settings.answer: Yes. Set it up once in the parent app on your home Wi-Fi.

settings.question: What if it breaks?
settings.answer: Every Snuggo has a 1-year warranty. Unused Snuggos can come back within 30 days in their original packaging.
